copy.igCaption:
Your garage door is the largest opening in your home — and usually the weakest. 🌪️

When a garage door fails in a storm, pressure floods the house and puts the whole roof at risk. An impact-rated door closes that gap for good. 💙

Free in-home assessment across South Florida. Call (954) 625-5318 to schedule.
copy.fbCaption: Did you know your garage door is usually the weakest point of your home in a hurricane? It's the largest opening in the house, and standard doors aren't built for hurricane-force winds. An impact-rated garage door protects your home, your vehicles, and everything in between. We've been protecting South Florida families since 2006 — free consultation and home visit, always. Call (954) 625-5318 or visit https://www.orlandotgroupinc.com/contact
